name: zypper
description: The package manager of openSUSE and SUSE Linux Enterprise, built on libzypp with strong dependency solving and repository management.

flags.description: Distribution upgrade — the openSUSE rolling/upgrade path.
Add a repository; lr lists repositories.

examples.command: sudo zypper ref && sudo zypper up
examples.explanation: The openSUSE update routine: refresh metadata, then apply updates.
Distribution upgrade: moves the whole system to the selected release — the supported way to follow openSUSE Tumbleweed.

about: zypper shares libzypp with YaST, openSUSE's administration suite. Its snapshot/rollback integration with btrfs+snapper can restore the entire system to a pre-update state after a bad upgrade.
useCases: Package management on openSUSE Leap and Tumbleweed.
mistakes: Using up where dup is needed when following Tumbleweed.
distroNotes: openSUSE and SUSE Linux Enterprise only.
